verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official hosted MCP server (mcp-v2) that Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, or Codex can connect to via OAuth. Its tools let agents fetch unaddressed PR comments, read the repository knowledge base, and view, search, and create coding patterns, with auto-fix workflows such as /check-pr and /greploop built on top. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
